Name: CP Mermaids Replace Old Mariner  Redux
Author: tigerne
Description:
This mod is an update/rewrite of Mioudew's Mermaid Replaces Mariner mod (found here), and it is come from [url=https://github.com/dragonmaus/mermaids-replace-old-mariner]Github[/url]﻿. The original mod has several issues (overwriting newer game content, overriding language selection, some minor grammatical problems), so I ripped it apart and created a proper Content Patcher mod from the pieces. (There is an unofficial Content Patcher update for the original, but it exhibits all of the same problematic behaviours as the XNB version.)
Known issues:
[list]
[*]The mod will only activate if you have your language set to English and Chinese. If you want to add more translations, please send to me.
[*]The three mermaids have essentially the same dialogue. I intend to give them some individual character at some point.
[/list]

这个 Mod 是 Mioudew 的 [i]Mermaid Replaces Mariner[/i]  mod（在 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2604]这里[/url]找到）的更新/重写，它来自[url=https://github.com/dragonmaus/mermaids-replace-old-mariner]Github [/url]﻿。 原来的Mod有几个问题（覆盖较新的游戏内容、覆盖语言选择、​​一些小的语法问题），所以我把它拆开并创建了一个合适的 CP Mod。（原始版本有一个非官方的 CP 更新，但它表现出与 XNB 版本相同的所有问题行为。）
[i]已知问题：[/i][list]
[*]仅当您将语言设置为英语和中文时，该模块才会激活。如果您想添加更多翻译，请发送给我。
[*]三个美人鱼的对话基本相同。
[/list]
N网不能发中文，有问题可以到贴吧：[url=http:]我的帖子[/url]反馈！
